title: I Just Bought $15,000 of a New Stock
creator: Couch Investor
summary: Weekly portfolio update: his portfolio gained 3.67% vs the S&P's 1.27%. He executed several trades. He bought 43 shares of Broadcom at $352 (~$15,000, ~2.4% of portfolio): AVGO is flat YTD despite >50% expected revenue growth, trades at 20.4x forward PE with a 0.5 PEG, and the CEO guided AI revenue doubling to $115B next fiscal year and doubling again to $230B after — this is a stance FLIP from conditional BUY to BUY. He plans to add NVDA (BUY, planned not executed) with ~$6K raised from a ~50% NFLX trim at ~$71 (SELL, valuation; kept half): NVDA is a 'no-brainer' buy-and-hold-forever at 18.7x forward PE / 0.5 PEG with avg PT $327, held back only by its $5.4T size. He also trimmed AMD 23.5% at ~$261 (FLIP from HOLD to SELL — growth now baked into price; keeps ~8.2% position) and RBRK 18.18% at ~$114 (SELL, likes company but 'very, very expensive'). Other calls: NU BUY at ~$14 (buy zone for long-term investors; Monzo $8-10B acquisition reports could pressure the stock near term); MU HOLD into the Sep 30 earnings — he expects beats across the board, argues record FCF ramp makes 'this time different,' and bets on a huge buyback once the company is allowed to repurchase shares in December. The video also covers a TA tour of holdings (GOOGL in buy zone $334 support/$350 resistance; RKLB ~$74; SOFI buy zone $15.8-16.8; AMZN at support $256 resistance; META $751, buy zone $680-710; NBIS $215-230; RDDT buy zone $166 resistance, watching AI licensing/Anthropic legal news; AXON buy zone $56 resistance; MELI $1,720-1,760; UBER buy zone $67.5-70.5) — no explicit calls on these. Note: auto-captions garble names ('Nebus' = NBIS, 'new' = NU, 'Marcado Libre').
